description: This file defines an interface named ExternalAPIPlugin, which specifies methods for handling external API interactions in the context of SuiteCRM / SugarCRM. The interface includes methods for checking supported authentication methods, loading data from EAPM beans, verifying login data, and logging off.

classes.name: ExternalAPIPlugin
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for external API integration, including support checks, data loading, login verification, and logout operations.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a certain authentication method is supported or returns the list of supported methods when called without arguments.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads data from an EAPM bean.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Verifies if the data from the EAPM bean are valid for login.

methods.name: logOff
methods.description: Logs out from the external API service.
